top_statements.statement: SELECT id, org_id, brand_profile_id, title, default_text, status, revision, created_at, updated_at, (SELECT jsonb_build_object('queue_id', membership.queue_id, 'queue_name', membership.queue_name, 'assigned_at', membership.assigned_at) FROM publishing_queue_memberships membership WHERE membership.post_id = posts.id AND membership.released_at IS NULL) AS queue_membership FROM posts WHERE posts.deleted_at IS NULL AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM brand_profiles bp WHERE bp.id = posts.brand_profile_id AND bp.deleted_at IS NULL ) ORDER BY posts.created_at DESC, posts.id DESC LIMIT $1 OFFSET $2

SELECT pa.post_id, pa.asset_id, pa.position, asset.id, asset.org_id, asset.brand_profile_id, asset.uploaded_by, asset.asset_type, asset.title, asset.duration_sec, asset.file_size, asset.mime_type, asset.width, asset.height, asset.original_filename, asset.status, asset.failure_code, asset.failure_message, asset.failure_retryable, asset.failure_at, asset.created_at, asset.updated_at FROM post_attachments AS pa JOIN assets AS asset ON asset.id = pa.asset_id AND asset.org_id = pa.org_id WHERE pa.post_id = ANY($1::uuid[]) ORDER BY pa.post_id, pa.position

SELECT post_id, platform_account_id, title_override, description_override, hashtags, provider_options, attachment_ids FROM post_targets WHERE post_id = ANY($1::uuid[]) ORDER BY post_id, created_at, platform_account_id

SELECT id, org_id, brand_profile_id, post_id, platform_account_id, platform, status, scheduled_at, published_at, platform_post_id, platform_url, title_override, description_override, hashtags, error_message, attempt_count, last_attempt_at, next_attempt_at, failure_code, failure_retryable, batch_id, created_at, updated_at, ( SELECT operation.publication_snapshot FROM provider_operations AS operation WHERE operation.distribution_id = distributions.id AND operation.operation = 'publish' AND operation.publication_snapshot IS NOT NULL ORDER BY operation.created_at DESC, operation.id DESC LIMIT 1 ) AS publication_snapshot FROM distributions WHERE post_id = ANY($1::uuid[]) ORDER BY post_id, event_at DESC, id DESC

SELECT d.post_id, d.id AS distribution_id, d.platform, snapshot.likes, snapshot.comments, snapshot.shares, snapshot.views, snapshot.impressions, snapshot.reach FROM distributions d JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT likes, comments, shares, views, impressions, reach FROM analytics_snapshots WHERE distribution_id = d.id ORDER BY snapshot_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1 ) snapshot ON true WHERE d.post_id = ANY($1::uuid[]) AND d.status = 'published' ORDER BY d.post_id, d.platform, d.id

SELECT id, org_id, brand_profile_id, title, default_text, status, revision, created_at, updated_at, (SELECT jsonb_build_object('queue_id', membership.queue_id, 'queue_name', membership.queue_name, 'assigned_at', membership.assigned_at) FROM publishing_queue_memberships membership WHERE membership.post_id = posts.id AND membership.released_at IS NULL) AS queue_membership FROM posts WHERE posts.id = $1 AND posts.deleted_at IS NULL AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM brand_profiles bp WHERE bp.id = posts.brand_profile_id AND bp.deleted_at IS NULL )

SELECT pa.post_id, pa.asset_id, pa.position, asset.id, asset.org_id, asset.brand_profile_id, asset.uploaded_by, asset.asset_type, asset.title, asset.duration_sec, asset.file_size, asset.mime_type, asset.width, asset.height, asset.original_filename, asset.status, asset.failure_code, asset.failure_message, asset.failure_retryable, asset.failure_at, asset.created_at, asset.updated_at FROM post_attachments AS pa JOIN assets AS asset ON asset.id = pa.asset_id AND asset.org_id = pa.org_id WHERE pa.post_id = ANY($1::uuid[]) ORDER BY pa.post_id, pa.position

SELECT post_id, platform_account_id, title_override, description_override, hashtags, provider_options, attachment_ids FROM post_targets WHERE post_id = ANY($1::uuid[]) ORDER BY post_id, created_at, platform_account_id

SELECT id, org_id, brand_profile_id, post_id, platform_account_id, platform, status, scheduled_at, published_at, platform_post_id, platform_url, title_override, description_override, hashtags, error_message, attempt_count, last_attempt_at, next_attempt_at, failure_code, failure_retryable, batch_id, created_at, updated_at, ( SELECT operation.publication_snapshot FROM provider_operations AS operation WHERE operation.distribution_id = distributions.id AND operation.operation = 'publish' AND operation.publication_snapshot IS NOT NULL ORDER BY operation.created_at DESC, operation.id DESC LIMIT 1 ) AS publication_snapshot FROM distributions WHERE post_id = ANY($1::uuid[]) ORDER BY post_id, event_at DESC, id DESC

SELECT d.post_id, d.id AS distribution_id, d.platform, snapshot.likes, snapshot.comments, snapshot.shares, snapshot.views, snapshot.impressions, snapshot.reach FROM distributions d JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT likes, comments, shares, views, impressions, reach FROM analytics_snapshots WHERE distribution_id = d.id ORDER BY snapshot_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1 ) snapshot ON true WHERE d.post_id = ANY($1::uuid[]) AND d.status = 'published' ORDER BY d.post_id, d.platform, d.id

SELECT id, org_id, brand_profile_id, post_id, platform_account_id, platform, status, scheduled_at, published_at, platform_post_id, platform_url, title_override, description_override, hashtags, error_message, attempt_count, last_attempt_at, next_attempt_at, failure_code, failure_retryable, batch_id, created_at, updated_at, ( SELECT operation.publication_snapshot FROM provider_operations AS operation WHERE operation.distribution_id = distributions.id AND operation.operation = 'publish' AND operation.publication_snapshot IS NOT NULL ORDER BY operation.created_at DESC, operation.id DESC LIMIT 1 ) AS publication_snapshot FROM distributions WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM brand_profiles bp WHERE bp.id = distributions.brand_profile_id AND bp.deleted_at IS NULL ) ORDER BY event_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT $1 OFFSET $2

SELECT d.id, d.post_id, p.title AS post_title, d.platform, d.platform_account_id, d.status, d.scheduled_at, d.published_at, d.updated_at, d.brand_profile_id FROM distributions d JOIN posts p ON p.id = d.post_id AND p.org_id = d.org_id WHERE d.event_at >= $1 AND d.event_at <= $2 AND p.deleted_at IS NULL AND ($4::uuid IS NULL OR d.brand_profile_id = $4) AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM brand_profiles bp WHERE bp.id = d.brand_profile_id AND bp.deleted_at IS NULL ) ORDER BY d.event_at ASC, d.id ASC LIMIT $3

WITH candidates AS ( SELECT id, platform FROM distributions WHERE status = 'published' AND published_at >= $1 AND published_at <= $2 AND ($3::text IS NULL OR platform = $3) AND ($4::uuid IS NULL OR brand_profile_id = $4) AND ($5::uuid IS NULL OR platform_account_id = $5) AND ($6::text IS NULL OR CASE WHEN COALESCE(array_length(distributions.attachment_ids, 1), 0) = 0 THEN 'text' WHEN array_length(distributions.attachment_ids, 1) > 1 THEN 'carousel' WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM assets AS format_asset WHERE format_asset.id = distributions.attachment_ids[1] AND format_asset.asset_type = 'video' ) THEN 'video' ELSE 'image' END = $6) AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM brand_profiles bp WHERE bp.id = brand_profile_id AND bp.deleted_at IS NULL ) ) SELECT c.platform, COALESCE(SUM(latest.views), 0) AS views, COALESCE(SUM(latest.likes), 0) AS likes, COALESCE(SUM(latest.comments), 0) AS comments, COALESCE(SUM(latest.shares), 0) AS shares, COALESCE(SUM(latest.watch_time_sec), 0) AS watch_time_sec, COALESCE(SUM(latest.reach), 0) AS reach, COALESCE(SUM(latest.impressions), 0) AS impressions, COUNT(*) AS post_count, MAX(latest.snapshot_at) AS last_synced_at FROM candidates c LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT s.views, s.likes, s.comments, s.shares, s.watch_time_sec, s.reach, s.impressions, s.snapshot_at FROM analytics_snapshots s WHERE s.distribution_id = c.id AND s.snapshot_at <= $2 ORDER BY s.snapshot_at DESC, s.id DESC LIMIT 1 ) latest ON true GROUP BY c.platform ORDER BY c.platform ASC

WITH candidates AS ( SELECT id, platform FROM distributions WHERE status = 'published' AND published_at >= $1 AND published_at <= $2 AND ($3::text IS NULL OR platform = $3) AND ($4::uuid IS NULL OR brand_profile_id = $4) AND ($5::uuid IS NULL OR platform_account_id = $5) AND ($6::text IS NULL OR CASE WHEN COALESCE(array_length(distributions.attachment_ids, 1), 0) = 0 THEN 'text' WHEN array_length(distributions.attachment_ids, 1) > 1 THEN 'carousel' WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM assets AS format_asset WHERE format_asset.id = distributions.attachment_ids[1] AND format_asset.asset_type = 'video' ) THEN 'video' ELSE 'image' END = $6) AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM brand_profiles bp WHERE bp.id = brand_profile_id AND bp.deleted_at IS NULL ) ) SELECT c.platform, COALESCE(SUM(latest.views), 0) AS views, COALESCE(SUM(latest.likes), 0) AS likes, COALESCE(SUM(latest.comments), 0) AS comments, COALESCE(SUM(latest.shares), 0) AS shares, COALESCE(SUM(latest.watch_time_sec), 0) AS watch_time_sec, COALESCE(SUM(latest.reach), 0) AS reach, COALESCE(SUM(latest.impressions), 0) AS impressions, COUNT(*) AS post_count, MAX(latest.snapshot_at) AS last_synced_at FROM candidates c LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT s.views, s.likes, s.comments, s.shares, s.watch_time_sec, s.reach, s.impressions, s.snapshot_at FROM analytics_snapshots s WHERE s.distribution_id = c.id AND s.snapshot_at <= $2 ORDER BY s.snapshot_at DESC, s.id DESC LIMIT 1 ) latest ON true GROUP BY c.platform ORDER BY c.platform ASC

WITH candidates AS ( SELECT id, platform FROM distributions WHERE status = 'published' AND published_at >= $1 AND published_at <= $2 AND ($3::text IS NULL OR platform = $3) AND ($4::uuid IS NULL OR brand_profile_id = $4) AND ($5::uuid IS NULL OR platform_account_id = $5) AND ($6::text IS NULL OR CASE WHEN COALESCE(array_length(distributions.attachment_ids, 1), 0) = 0 THEN 'text' WHEN array_length(distributions.attachment_ids, 1) > 1 THEN 'carousel' WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM assets AS format_asset WHERE format_asset.id = distributions.attachment_ids[1] AND format_asset.asset_type = 'video' ) THEN 'video' ELSE 'image' END = $6) AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM brand_profiles bp WHERE bp.id = brand_profile_id AND bp.deleted_at IS NULL ) ) SELECT c.platform, COALESCE(SUM(latest.views), 0) AS views, COALESCE(SUM(latest.likes), 0) AS likes, COALESCE(SUM(latest.comments), 0) AS comments, COALESCE(SUM(latest.shares), 0) AS shares, COALESCE(SUM(latest.watch_time_sec), 0) AS watch_time_sec, COALESCE(SUM(latest.reach), 0) AS reach, COALESCE(SUM(latest.impressions), 0) AS impressions, COUNT(*) AS post_count, MAX(latest.snapshot_at) AS last_synced_at FROM candidates c LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT s.views, s.likes, s.comments, s.shares, s.watch_time_sec, s.reach, s.impressions, s.snapshot_at FROM analytics_snapshots s WHERE s.distribution_id = c.id AND s.snapshot_at <= $2 ORDER BY s.snapshot_at DESC, s.id DESC LIMIT 1 ) latest ON true GROUP BY c.platform ORDER BY c.platform ASC
SELECT platform, platform_user_id, access_token, connection_status, token_expires_at, revoked_at FROM platform_accounts WHERE id = $1 LIMIT 1
SELECT platform, platform_user_id, access_token, connection_status, token_expires_at, revoked_at FROM platform_accounts WHERE id = $1 LIMIT 1

SELECT c.id, c.distribution_id, d.platform, c.platform_comment_id, c.author_name, c.author_avatar, c.body, c.reply_text, c.reply_status, c.reply_error, c.reply_attempted_at, c.commented_at, c.synced_at, c.updated_at, d.brand_profile_id, d.post_id FROM comments c JOIN distributions d ON d.id = c.distribution_id AND d.org_id = c.org_id WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM brand_profiles bp WHERE bp.id = d.brand_profile_id AND bp.deleted_at IS NULL ) ORDER BY c.commented_at DESC, c.id DESC LIMIT $1 OFFSET $2

SELECT id, org_id, brand_profile_id, uploaded_by, asset_type, title, duration_sec, file_size, mime_type, width, height, original_filename, status, failure_code, failure_message, failure_retryable, failure_at, created_at, updated_at FROM assets WHERE id = $1 AND org_id = public.auth_active_org_id() AND status != 'deleted' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM brand_profiles bp WHERE bp.id = assets.brand_profile_id AND bp.deleted_at IS NULL )

SELECT id, org_id, asset_id, strategy, status, content_type, file_size, object_key, multipart_upload_id, part_size, part_count, max_parallel_parts, expires_at FROM asset_upload_sessions WHERE id = $1 AND org_id = public.auth_active_org_id() FOR UPDATE
UPDATE asset_objects SET write_hold_until = GREATEST(write_hold_until, $3::timestamptz), updated_at = now() WHERE asset_id = $1 AND kind = 'staging' AND r2_key = $2 AND status <> 'deleted'

SELECT id, org_id, brand_profile_id, uploaded_by, asset_type, title, duration_sec, file_size, mime_type, width, height, original_filename, status, failure_code, failure_message, failure_retryable, failure_at, created_at, updated_at FROM assets WHERE id = $1 AND org_id = public.auth_active_org_id() AND status != 'deleted' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM brand_profiles bp WHERE bp.id = assets.brand_profile_id AND bp.deleted_at IS NULL )
